title: Tree Inventory Data from Permanent Plots in French Forest Reserves
author: CATEAU, Eugénie
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Conduct Fixed‑Area Inventory
steps.instruction: Within each permanent plot, inventory regeneration, standing dead trees, living trees, and coarse woody debris (CWD) with diameter greater than 30 cm using a fixed‑area method.

steps.title: Survey CWD on Transects
steps.instruction: Lay transect lines across the plot and record all CWD pieces with diameter ≥ 30 cm, applying a relascopic angle of 3 % for detection.

steps.title: Record Tree Measurements
steps.instruction: For every tree or CWD recorded, measure and note the exact location (azimuth and distance), species, diameter(s), tree‑related microhabitats, decay stage, bark cover, and seedling cover.
